capabilities: Sync a vault with a GitHub repository via the GitHub REST API
Sync automatically on a fixed interval or manually via ribbon button and command
Resolve conflicts in a split or unified diff view or auto-prefer remote/local
Optionally sync the .obsidian config folder, including plugins and themes
Reset plugin settings and sync metadata
disambiguation: Despite the name, it uses no git at all: no branching, merging, or rebasing, and it only syncs with GitHub, not other git hosts.
extras: README warns the plugin must not be used alongside other sync plugins because of its custom metadata file; the first sync requires one side (repo or vault) to be empty; syncing the .obsidian folder on a public repository exposes your token; file-type filtering is still TODO.
intentEvidence: Most of those plugins though require the git executable to be present in your system
motivation: The author wanted the same syncing experience on every platform, especially mobile, without relying on git being installed.
problem: Other GitHub sync plugins require the git executable on your system and are hard to use on Windows and unstable on mobile.

requires.name: GitHub fine-grained token with Contents read/write permission

summary: Syncs an Obsidian vault with a GitHub repository using the GitHub REST API, with no git executable needed, on desktop and mobile.
